description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController. It provides several endpoints including a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info. The class uses Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for the application, including welcome, documentation redirect, health status, and info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: info
